app-store.name: App Store
app-store.description: Browse the catalog, install what you need, and remove apps you no longer use — without leaving the desktop.

desktop-shell-settings.name: Desktop settings
desktop-shell-settings.description: Tune theme, wallpaper, icons, window chrome, and performance so the desktop feels like yours.

app-content.name: File manager
app-content.description: Browse your library, find files by name, and open documents and media without hunting across folders.

app-ugs.name: UGS Studio
app-ugs.description: Create and steer image work in the studio dashboard. Follow jobs and history in UGS Hub.

app-ugs-hub.name: UGS Hub
app-ugs-hub.description: See active jobs, past runs, and the generation queue in one quiet place.

app-ewrp.name: Presentations
app-ewrp.description: Build a presentation from a landing story: refine copy, pick visuals, export PDF for the meeting or the room that joins later.

app-studio-gu.name: Voice Studio
app-studio-gu.description: Talk by voice, run the command center, use live voice, and turn recordings into text — in one studio window.

app-docs.name: Document editor
app-docs.description: Shape documents with headings, lists, and tables, and write with colleagues without losing the thread across versions.

app-doc-editor-v2.name: Document Editor V2
app-doc-editor-v2.description: Collaborate on documents with the Assistant beside you, plus import and export when you need to move work in or out.

app-image-studio.name: Image Studio
app-image-studio.description: Describe the image you want, or refine an existing frame with a short instruction — stay in one studio from request to result.

app-video-studio.name: Video Studio
app-video-studio.description: Turn a still into a short motion clip without jumping between tools.

app-social-hub.name: Connections
app-social-hub.description: Friend requests, contacts, circles, privacy, and the phone companion — one door into your social layer.

app-gaf-chat.name: Messenger
app-gaf-chat.description: Private one-to-one chats with friends: messages, history, unread cues, and open-from-notification — without group noise.

app-video-call.name: Video call
app-video-call.description: Start an internal video call with another person on the service — camera and mic when you need them.

app-desktop-ai-chat.name: Experts
app-desktop-ai-chat.description: Talk with an expert who remembers the thread and attachments. Optionally pin a project workspace, tools, and voice so focus stays in one place.

app-music-forge.name: Song studio
app-music-forge.description: Describe the song you imagine — the studio shapes lyrics, style, and a playable track without scattering drafts.

app-music-player.name: Music player
app-music-player.description: Play audio from your Music library and nearby folders — play, pause, and seek without hunting for the file.

app-notifications.name: Notification center
app-notifications.description: One hub for notification history, filters, and sound preferences across messengers and studios.

app-calendar.name: Calendar
app-calendar.description: Keep personal events in a month or week view — your calendar, not the Assistant plan.

app-widget-shelf.name: Notes & tasks
app-widget-shelf.description: Notes and task lists that stay on your desktop when you need a quick capture.

app-dashboard-favorites.name: Favorites
app-dashboard-favorites.description: Jump to the widget panels you use most without digging through the desktop.

app-ewdesk.name: EWDesk
app-ewdesk.description: Company news and announcements in one place so updates are not lost in chat.

app-survey-hub.name: Surveys
app-survey-hub.description: Take interactive surveys and earn rewards for honest participation.

app-about-project.name: About the project
app-about-project.description: An interactive walk through EliteEW — ecosystem, apps, and what you can do here.

app-marketing-cabinet.name: Marketing hall
app-marketing-cabinet.description: From home to project: positioning, evidence, and oracles in one marketing hall — without scattered tables.

app-poemma.name: POEMMA
app-poemma.description: Zoya’s business map: meaning, the next ninety days, profit, experience, and the next actions — visible at a glance.

app-empery-nexus-chronicle.name: Empery Nexus
app-empery-nexus-chronicle.description: A living chronicle of the EliteEW world — layers of story and reality you can explore without leaving the desktop.

app-ewa.name: Assistant
app-ewa.description: Your constant desktop Assistant — calm conversation and a steady presence when you need a partner.

app-assistant.name: Reference Navigation
app-assistant.description: Product navigation: ready FAQ answers and a chat that helps you find your way around EliteEW.

app-feedback-hub.name: Feedback
app-feedback-hub.description: Share ideas, wishes, and bug reports so the product can improve from real use.

app-professional-worlds.name: Professional Worlds
app-professional-worlds.description: A specialist workspace: profile, learning, objects, clients, and smart hints in one professional world.

app-site-studio.name: Site studio
app-site-studio.description: Build and publish a personal site — content, storefront, admin, and a safe guest view that never opens your private desktop.

app-site-manager-ops.name: Site control
app-site-manager-ops.description: Operator view of sites: service readiness, jobs, domains, publish checks, and an event log.

app-local-service.name: Local Service
app-local-service.description: Open a local service interface running on this computer in an embedded desktop window.

app-kirs.name: KIRS
app-kirs.description: Curate a project site: choose a template, publish, and hand a clean client view without sharing your desk.

app-kirs-client-site.name: My site
app-kirs-client-site.description: Open the project storefront when you arrive from KIRS — guest-safe browsing of the published site.

widget-clipboard.name: Clipboard
widget-clipboard.description: Keep a short history of what you copied so you can paste again without re-finding the source.

app-kursorina.description: An investigator that searches your materials and the open web, gathers evidence, and answers the case — or stops honestly when it cannot.
app-kursorina.name: Kursorina

app-ebrowser.description: Browse allowed HTTPS sites inside EliteEW with navigation policy and camera, microphone, and sound controls under your hand.
app-ebrowser.name: EBrowser
